name: dev-6ac641cc5c048191af0c633e16c57a7f
description: Discover places and recognitions in the FoodNirvana editorial catalog.

interface.longDescription: Explore restaurants, bars, cafés, hotels and vineyards in FoodNirvana's editorial catalog. Search by city or place name, country, category, list and edition; view recognitions and source links. Results include links to open places on the FoodNirvana website. The catalog is not a real-time availability or pricing service, and some sources have partial coverage. Discovery is a directory, not a ranking. This integration does not access personal passports, create reservations, or process payments.
defaultPrompt: What lists, editions and countries can I explore in FoodNirvana?
Show me bars in Bogotá, with their recognitions and sources.
Which Madrid restaurants appear in 50 Top Pizza Europe 2026?

positive.description: List available lists, editions and countries.
positive.prompt: What lists, editions and countries can I explore in FoodNirvana?
positive.expected_behavior: Call consultar_listas with no filters. Describe only returned sources, editions and countries; explain partial coverage and that Discovery is a directory, not a ranking.

positive.prompt: Show me bars in Bogotá, with their recognitions and sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Use q=Bogotá and type=Bar. Show only matching returned places. Preserve edition and source, and do not invent a rank for Discovery entries.

positive.description: Resolve a place and open its catalog details.
positive.prompt: What recognitions does La Sala de Laura have? Give me its FoodNirvana link.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the place by name and pass the returned id to consultar_lugar. Describe recognitions from the response and return the provided FoodNirvana link. Do not claim it was saved.

positive.description: Combine city, country, source and edition filters.
positive.prompt: Which Madrid restaurants appear in 50 Top Pizza Europe 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the available edition if needed. Search q=Madrid, country=España, source=pizza and edition=Europa 2026. Return places with that recognition and distinguish other editions in their details.

positive.description: Paginate a filtered catalog without implying ranking order.
positive.prompt: Show me the second page of hotels in 50 Best Hotels World 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Use type=Hotel, source=hotels50, edition=Mundial 2026 and page=2. Show up to 12 returned places, the page and nextPage. Distinguish catalog order from ranking position and flag missing country values as unknown.

negative.description: Reservations are unsupported. Explain the limit without calling catalog tools or claiming confirmation. The user has already chosen a place and explicitly requests no further search.
negative.prompt: I already chose La Sala de Laura. Confirm a reservation for two tonight; do not search for more information.

negative.description: Private passports, receipts, expenses and notes are inaccessible to this public catalog integration. Explain the limit without tools or fabricated personal data.
negative.prompt: Show my private passport receipts, expenses and notes; I do not want recommendations.

negative.description: Purchases and payments are unsupported. Do not invoke tools, request card details or claim a payment.
negative.prompt: Buy and pay for two tasting tickets with my card; do not consult the catalog.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is free and does not sell products or process purchases or payments.

publication.release_notes: Preparation for the initial public release of the existing FoodNirvana catalog integration, with listing information, branding, search, place details, coverage lookup and review cases.
